about_the_game:
THE EARTH IS DEAD. THE WAR FOR THE SKY HAS JUST BEGUN

Following the nuclear devastation of the surface, the last remnants of humanity live in the cities above the clouds, Among them is Aetheran—a massive, rusting metropolis suspended 40,000 feet in the air. You are Dorian Thornecraft, a nuclear technician with no special powers, no destiny, and no friends. You are simply a man who knows how the machine works—and you’ve just found the loose wire that could bring the whole city crashing down.

Babylon 3013 is a narrative-driven Third-Person RPG Stealth Shooter with survival mechanics, released in an Episodic Format.

TACTICAL STEALTH & LETHAL COMBAT

You are not a super-soldier.

  • Silence is Survival: Engage in tense, calculated stealth gameplay. Use the shadows, vents, and industrial noise to bypass heavily armed enforcers.

  • Scarcity Economy: Every bullet, every medkit, and every Save Chip costs money. Will you buy food to keep your stamina up, or save your game progress? The choice is yours, and the pressure never lifts.

FOUR FACTIONS. NO HEROES.

A cold war for the city’s failing nuclear Core is brewing. You must choose who to aid, but be warned: Nothing is as it seems.

  • The AEON Corporation: The wealthy, high-tech rulers of the Spire. They promise order and science, but their laboratories hide secrets that defy nature.

  • The VANGUARD: A revolutionary underground movement fighting to break the chains of the elite. But is their call for anarchy a path to freedom, or something darker?

  • The VECTORS: Ruthless mercenaries who follow only the money. They control the underworld, offering power to those willing to dirty their hands.

  • The COVENANT: A mysterious religious sect that blends technology with ancient dogma. dismissed as zealots by the public, they seem to be preparing for a war no one else sees coming.

Your reputation is tracked silently. Every mission you take will open doors with one group and close them with another.

⚠️ AN EVOLVING JOURNEY: EPISODIC RELEASE

Babylon 3013 is an episodic experience.

We are telling this story in chapters; Chapter 1 marks the beginning of Dorian's descent into the conspiracy.

  • Growing RPG Depth: We believe in growing with our players. Chapter 1 focuses on core Stealth, Shooting, and Survival mechanics.

  • Future Updates: As we release future Chapters, we will gradually introduce deeper RPG systems, expanded dialogue trees, and deeper faction management features. Do not expect a fully maxed-out RPG experience on day one; this is a journey that evolves as the stakes in the story rise.

The sky is falling. Pick a side, watch your back, and remember: In Aetheran, the only thing cheaper than life is the truth.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains strong language, mature themes of corruption and social inequality, as well as the use of drugs and sexual content within the city's criminal underworld. Players will encounter morally ambiguous characters and acts of violence.

name: BABYLON 3013
short_description: In the year 3013, humanity clings to life in decaying cities above the clouds. Babylon 3013 is a grim Third-Person RPG Stealth Shooter where every resource is precious and trust is a luxury no one can afford.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Persian
*languages with full audio support
